headline: WSN @ TBR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is WSN 4.98 at TBR 4.42, with a projected total of 9.40. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward WSN: WSN moved +0.87 runs while TBR moved -0.03, changing the projected margin by +0.90 runs. The projected total climbed +0.77, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Ian Seymour has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Nasim Nuñez, James Wood, CJ Abrams, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Chandler Simpson because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
